arabic text: Bete na bhayi nana Jaise gayi thi Zainab, waise na aayi nana
english translation text: Neither sons nor brothers remain, Grandfather. Zainab did not return as she had departed, Grandfather.

arabic text: Turbat rula rahi thi masooma bewatan ki\nPewast qaidiyon ke zakhmon me thi rasan bhi\nThi qaid se ziyada mushkil rihayi nana
english translation text: The grave of the innocent exile made us weep.\nRopes remained embedded within the prisoners' wounds.\nFreedom was even harder than captivity, Grandfather.

arabic text: Woh gham kisi nabi ke beton ne bhi na dekhe\nHar mor har qadam pe badr o ohad ke badle\nJo teri betion ne qeemat chukaai nana
english translation text: Such grief was not seen even by the sons of prophets.\nAt every turn and every step, your daughters paid the price\nfor the revenge of Badr and Uhud, Grandfather.

arabic text: Qatle hussain jaise zainab pe woh ghari thi\nZaalim ke samne jab darbar me khari thi\nYaad aaye mujh ko is dam athara bhai nana
english translation text: Standing before the tyrant in the court\nfelt to Zainab like Hussain's killing.\nAt that moment I remembered my eighteen brothers, Grandfather.

arabic text: Yoon khums mil raha tha chehre badal gai thi\nShole kisi ne phainke pathar kisi ne maary\nMujrim tha tera kunba munsif khudai nana
english translation text: This was how khums was distributed; faces had changed.\nSome threw flames, and others stones.\nYour family stood accused, while cruelty itself was judge, Grandfather.

arabic text: Hai naksh zehn o dil per aashoor ka woh manzar\nGhurbat ki shaam me na bhooloongi zindagi bhar\nWoh be kafan janaza aur be ridai nana
english translation text: The scene of Ashura remains engraved upon my heart and mind.\nThroughout life I will never forget the evening of exile:\nthat unshrouded body and our unveiled state, Grandfather.

arabic text: Umat ne yoon sataya shabir ki behen ko\nBe gor chor aayi har laash be kafan ko\nBas dil me hasraton ki turbat banayi nana
english translation text: The nation tormented Shabbir's sister in this way.\nI left every body unburied and unshrouded,\nand built only graves of longing within my heart, Grandfather.

arabic text: Ghash kar gayi ye keh kar muhsin ali ki beti\nTera kalma parhne waale kehte the humko baaghi\nHar samt se yehi ik awaaz aayi nana
english translation text: Ali's daughter fainted after saying:\nthose who recite your kalima called us rebels.\nThe same cry came from every direction, Grandfather.

arabic text: Unmat be yoon sataya shabir ki behen ko\nBe gor chor aayi har laash be kafan ko Bas dil me hasraton ki turbat banayi nana
english translation text: The nation tormented Shabbir's sister in this way. I left every body\nunburied and unshrouded, and built only graves of longing within my heart, Grandfather.
